role: Joey macro — purple-and-yellow beards on stamen filaments
creator: Joey Santore
source_context: The purple-and-yellow tufts are hairs on the filaments, not extra petals. Tinantia has six fertile stamens; five filaments are bearded, with the lower central filament smooth. Compare this image directly with Commelina erecta's smooth filament macro. The little white lower petal is also visible.

role: Side view — exposed cyme above an open leaflike bract
creator: River Wilder
source_context: Trace the stalk from the open flower past the buds to the broad green bract below the cluster. The bract spreads outward instead of enclosing the entire cluster in a fused Commelina-style pocket. The boatlike green coverings immediately around individual buds are sepals; do not confuse those with a spathe.
